name: China Restaurant Shang-Hai
kurzbeschreibung: Shang-Hai China Restaurant in Tirol Discover authentic Chinese flavors in the heart of Tirol!
beschreibung: At the China Restaurant Shang-Hai in the Außerfern region, warm alpine hospitality takes center stage. The restaurant features a welcoming setting and a menu pairing authentic Tyrolean recipes with contemporary culinary flair. Ingredients are chosen carefully from regional suppliers, ensuring top-tier freshness and flavor. Comfortable alpine wooden furnishings create a relaxing environment. A standout highlight is the sun veranda boasting panoramic views of the alpine peaks, inviting guests to sit back and savor the scenery.
